instruction.text: This is a map of England in the early 800s. Label the kingdoms.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: In the early 800s, most of England was dominated by the Kingdom of Mercia. Egbert became King of Wessex in AD 802 and wanted to expand his own kingdom.
atoms.sound: In the early 800s, most of England was dominated by the Kingdom of Mercya. Egbert became King of Wessex in AD 802 and wanted to expand his own kingdom.

atoms.text: In AD 825, Wessex won a decisive battle against Mercia at Ellendun. As a result of this victory, many of the kingdoms under Mercian control were taken by Wessex or now allied with them.
atoms.sound: In AD 825, Wessex won a decisive battle against Mercya at Ellendun. As a result of this victory, many of the kingdoms under Mercyan control were taken by Wessex or now allied with them.

atoms.a: Which Kingdom dominated England when Egbert became king?
Who won at the Battle of Ellendun?

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to learn about what Egbert did next.

atoms.b: In AD 829, Egbert led a successful invasion of ((++Mercia America)). As a result, the Mercian king, Wiglaf, was driven from his ((++throne chair)).
atoms.sound: In AD 829, Egbert led a successful invasion of Mercya. As a result, the Mercyan king, Wiglaf, was driven from his throne.

atoms.b: He gained control of the London Mint, which allowed him to make his own ((++coins swords)), and he even successfully invaded parts of ((++Northumbria Iceland)) and Wales.
After this, Egbert was named ((++bretwalda emperor)), a title only held by 7 previous rulers at the time.
atoms.hint: Bretwalda means wide-ruler. It is used to describe a king who controlled most or all of England.

atoms.b: ((++Wiglaf Caesar)) was able to regain control of Mercia in AD 830, however, it was never as powerful again.
atoms.sound: Wiglaf was able to regain control of Mercya in AD 830, however, it was never as powerful again.
